summary: Fixes a change in Sales Line behaviour around the VAT Prod. field that has been observed since Business Central 28.4. The same one-line change is made to table 37 Sales Line in 12 layers, and new tests are added for documents with prices including VAT.
key_points: Fixes a regression in Sales Line behaviour related to the VAT Prod. field, seen since version 28.4
The same one-line change is applied to table 37 Sales Line in 12 layers
Adds tests to the ERM Prices Incl. VAT Doc test codeunits for W1 and ES
